I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I couldn't confirm OPS-9674 from anything she has access to.

- She can't see any shared files for Tansley Parcel, and the brain only has her own message about the ticket.
- Tansley is a Central team account. A public planning note calls it "Pree's biggest account", which I took to mean Priyanka's, though the note doesn't spell that out. The incident channel for Tansley is Central-only, so I didn't read it on her behalf.
- I told her I'm treating the number as an unverified rumour and won't pass it on as fact. I pointed her to Priyanka or Hollis on the Central team for the real ticket number.

No approval was needed: ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures.
